prompts.board:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a precise functional animation KEYFRAME STORYBOARD for the provided game skill-command UI. The provided image is the immutable base design. Show exact same asymmetric coral red open-loop framework, thin compact S links, top dot and droplets, with orange flame TOP / sky-blue shield MIDDLE / green sprout-through-rock BOTTOM. No black/gray disks within the rings. No arrows or keyboard letters. No redesign of outlines, no alternate button shapes.
Canvas: large square or near-square storyboard, flat uniform muted dark navy presentation background (#182735), 3 clearly separated horizontal rows, 4 equal columns. Each cell shows ONE complete tall 3-button vertical group, same size and baseline. Keep room for small clean captions. Header: "SKILL COMMANDS · MOTION". Row titles in English to avoid typography errors.
ROW 1 "VALID PRESS · 0.26 s": columns "0.00 REST", "0.04 COMPRESS", "0.10 REBOUND", "0.26 SETTLE". Only TOP flame symbol responds, compress 91%, rebound 107%, return100%; a restrained apricot/cream highlight travels a short arc around top ring only then disappears. Frame geometry stationary, other two symbols unchanged. No persistent filled circle, no large light blast. This is valid input feedback, not a second success effect.
ROW 2 "NO MATCH · RESET / LOCK 0.28 s": columns "0.00 REJECT", "0.06 MUTE", "0.16 RESET", "0.28 READY". Whole group briefly desaturates/mutes to grayish coral and icons compress to94%, then gently returns to exact base design. No red cross, no word ERROR painted on buttons, no shake, no fragments. Small unobtrusive LOCK caption under middle two cells, READY under final cell. Do not remove any symbol. There is no input accepted while locked.
ROW 3 "FULL COMMAND · RELEASE / LOCK 0.38 s": columns "0.00 TRIGGER", "0.08 CONNECT", "0.18 PULSE", "0.38 READY". A restrained cream highlight follows the EXISTING S-shaped connection downwards, three symbols make ONE coordinated gentle expand-and-settle pulse to106%. A FEW tiny tapered paint-spark dashes outside lower endpoint, then fade fully by final cell. All frame shapes and icon colors remain identifiable; no giant particles or flames. LOCK caption in first three cells, READY in final. Whole group returns to exactly base artwork. No perpetual glow, no opaque disk.
Use ghost-free crisp keyframes, gentle small glow only on active strokes, original silhouette unchanged. The storyboard is a design illustration, not screenshots of an implemented game. Do not introduce characters, scenery, HP bars or other HUD. Keep the top courage / middle guardian / bottom tenacity order identical in all 12 cells.
